exposure: Timing of opioid prescription (day of discharge vs. day before)
Date of delivery (before or after ACOG Committee Opinion 742)
cohort: Patients who had a live cesarean birth at a rural Midwest facility between July 2017 and February 2021
finding: The day of opioid prescription did not impact prescribing trends, but patients who delivered after the ACOG guidelines received fewer MMEs and doses per day.
